artworks.title: Landscape with trees and mountains
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Innes Homer
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of an expansive field with a low horizon line, distant hills or mountains, clusters of trees, a few scattered trees, and a house among the trees on the right. The image is in sepia tones, with a soft and serene atmosphere, and features small haystacks or bushes in the field.

artworks.title: Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Innes Homer
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated or slightly leaning, captured from the waist up. Her head is tilted to one side, with her gaze averted from the camera. She has delicate facial features and a serene expression. Her hair is styled in an intricate updo under a large, dark, slightly tilted hat. She wears a high-necked dress with ruffled fabric around the chest and shoulders. The background is plain with a soft-focus texture.

artworks.title: Landscape with trees
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Innes Homer
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly blurred natural landscape. The view is from ground level, focusing on two closely spaced trees with branches extending towards the sky. A ridgeline of bushy vegetation marks the low horizon. The color tones are soft and sepia, giving the image a vintage look. Shadows are gentle, blending into the light. The edges are less defined, creating a sense of calm ambiguity beyond the trees and vegetation.

artworks.title: Gardeuse d'Anes Merchant (The Donkey Herder)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, folded to the contours of the copper plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a scene with figures, animals, buildings, and a cloudy sky in a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: Feuilles d'Anes du Midi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a group of pack donkeys with a person among them in a mountainous landscape. The artwork features fine, detailed linework and cross-hatching in sepia-toned ink, depicting the scene with donkeys carrying baskets and bags, along with a robed figure standing beside them.

artworks.title: A Young Nun
artworks.medium: graphite and black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the shoulders up, facing the viewer with a gentle expression. She has a subtle smile, serene countenance, fair complexion, and is wearing a traditional nun's headdress. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Schreiberhau
artworks.medium: brush and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a landscape view with a vantage point slightly above ground level. The horizon shows a line of trees and a church with a tall spire. The church and other buildings are in the middle distance, with trees scattered around them. The scene is in grayscale, with a soft brushwork style resembling watercolor or ink wash. The color palette is various shades of gray, creating a serene atmosphere. In the foreground, a cobblestone path and a wooden barrel are visible, with fences and greenery. The sky in the background is mostly blank, highlighting the structures and foliage below.

artworks.title: Profile of a Man with Sidewhiskers
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man's head and part of his neck in profile view. The man is looking to the left, showcasing his facial features. He has a prominent nose, cheekbones, dark hair with hints of gray at the sides, and a white beard under his chin. He is wearing a gray collar that is partially visible. The background is a plain, muted brown color. There are no objects or jewelry visible in the image.

artworks.title: Stage Design for a Domed Temple Interior with a Sun Disk above the Altar
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Professor William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricately designed pavilion with columns supporting an octagonal dome. The interior features detailed ceiling panels and a central wheel-like structure. The pillars are adorned with elaborate designs and the drawing conveys a sense of depth and grandeur through perspective, light, and shadow.

artworks.title: Feuilles d'Anes du Midi (Sheet of Donkeys from the South)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a group of donkeys and a person surrounded by them in a mountainous terrain with a distant town in the background. The style used is classic etching, featuring meticulous line work for forms and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic with black lines on a cream background. The donkeys are loaded with goods in the forefront, while the mountains gently fade into the distance.

artworks.title: Les Petits Anes de Luchon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four horses standing in front of a wooded area. The scene comprises four horses aligned in the foreground, sketched with strong lines and shading. In the background, there are hints of natural elements, indicating a wooded or dense area. The artist has used bold strokes to convey textures of the setting, with an emphasis on light and shadow interplay across the subjects in the composition.

artworks.title: Les Petits Anes de Luchon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals gathered together. The drawing uses fine lines and hatching techniques to render the details of the animals and the background. The figures of the animals are composed of bold, dark strokes that contrast with the lighter, sketchier areas of the surrounding area. The composition is dense with patterns created by the animal's stripes, giving a sense of movement and energy. In the background, subtle textures suggest a natural environment with undefined foliage or structures.

artworks.title: Le Puits de la Butte-aux-Cailles
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground, there is a waterway with a person and a donkey. Beyond, the terrain becomes slightly undulating with sparse vegetation. In the distance, there is a windmill with smaller structures nearby. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with dense clouds in the sky. The image is an etching with fine, hatched lines for texture and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and tan on a muted beige background.

artworks.title: Forêt
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view, depicting a forest with dense foliage. Tree trunks and branches define the space in a style resembling etching or woodcut with bold, dark lines creating leaf and texture patterns. The trees create a canopy effect and a monochrome color palette of black and beige accentuates the high contrast and graphic quality. The ground and base of trees are detailed with dark lines, and dense layers of textured lines in the distance convey the thickness of the forest. Natural forms and shadows are emphasized in a balanced composition.

artworks.title: Forêt
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with dense foliage, tree trunks, and a hidden horizon line. The style appears to be a fine engraving or etching with intricate patterns depicting the texture of the foliage. The monochromatic palette uses dark and light contrasts to define the trees and ground. The ground has patterns leading into the forest, while lighter spaces in the distance suggest openings among the trees, creating a play of light and darkness.

artworks.title: L'Etang de la Bièvre (The Beaver Pond)
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a marshy landscape with horizon slightly above center, featuring silhouettes of buildings and smokestacks. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, resembling etchings. The color palette is primarily sepia, with variations indicating light and shade. Reeds and aquatic plants in the foreground are drawn with clear lines, hinting at a pond or marsh. In the distance, there are indistinct shapes of grazing horses and buildings.

artworks.title: Ex-libris de Léon Lerey (Ex-libris of Leon Lerey)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image features a violin and an open book of music score in the foreground, flanked by detailed carvings and an ornate pillar. Above, two cherubs hold up a banner labeled "EX LIBRIS" with intricate etching. To the left, a scene of ships in a harbor is depicted. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving it an antique appearance.

artworks.title: Le Chateau des Hiboux; Ex-libris de Léon Lerey
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an owl-themed ex libris illustration. It consists of two sections: a nocturnal scene with owls on the left and an ex libris design on the right. The left side shows owls in a dark scene with a crescent moon and a castle-like structure in the background. The right side includes the words "EXLIBRIS" at the top, an open book, decorative swirls, and a figure next to books and other objects. The drawing has a mysterious and curious mood with a subdued color palette.

artworks.title: Quatre Anons dans un Prè
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows several donkeys grazing on grass in a pastoral scene. The perspective is direct, showing the animals feeding. One donkey is resting with its head up, while three others are standing and eating. The horizon is low, with light sketching of distant landscape features. The etching technique uses precise lines and fine detailing, including cross-hatching and varied line density for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of brown and sepia. The scene conveys rustic simplicity and rural life, with loosely sketched trees and structures in the background.

artworks.title: L'Anesse Marie-Jeanne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a donkey with a load on its back standing near a rustic building, with chickens around. The background includes trees and clouds, adding to the countryside setting. The drawing features fine lines and hatching for detailing.

artworks.title: Mercedes de Cordoba
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Innes Homer
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, reclining in a wicker chair. Her head is tilted back, with her gaze directed upward. She has long, dark hair and is wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved dress with lace or embroidery. Beside her is a piece of furniture, likely a table, with unclear objects on it. The room is softly lit, with shadows and light coming through a window, creating an ambient atmosphere.

artworks.title: Woods at Night with Travelers
artworks.medium: brush and gray wash with heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper, laid down on blue album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a dense forest scene from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is not visible as trees dominate the composition. The scene is vertically oriented with tall trees extending from close to us into the distance. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, especially in the depiction of leaves and branches, creating a textured forest canopy. The color palette consists of muted gray and green tones, evoking a somber atmosphere with subdued light filtering through. Light and shadow play among the trees and leaves, adding depth to the scene. In the distance, a narrow path winds through the trees, with small figures faintly visible, providing scale to the towering trees.

artworks.title: John Ruskin
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man in a waist-up profile view, sitting in a chair with his hands clasped in his lap. He is facing to the right, leaning back against the chair. The man has a long, light-colored beard and hair, with defined facial features including a prominent nose. He is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored shirt visible at the collar. The background is dimly lit, with a stack of books or papers faintly visible on a surface behind him.

artworks.title: The Banks of the Severn, near Winterdyne
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape seen through a circular frame. Trees with dark branches and leaves are close to us on both sides, with a body of water reflecting light further back. In the distance, there are hills that blend into the sky. The colors are soft sepia tones, creating a vintage feel.
